name: Matthew A. Scherb
office: Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Eight

items.text: Matthew A. Scherb is an Associate Justice of the Second District Court of Appeal, Division Eight, appointed in 2025. He was previously a California Supreme Court chambers attorney, an appellate court attorney, and a Los Angeles deputy city attorney. In 2026, he ruled that a TikTok post about a plastic surgery clinic’s staff lacked anti-SLAPP protection. He joined a ruling that disclosing the existence of sex-related videos was unprotected.
